% ss_prose_good.tex — study-guide document whose worked-example prose agrees
% with ss_prose.json: every prose number is a JSON given/expected value OR a
% >=2-decimal INTERMEDIATE equal to a subexpression of the entry's own expr
% at printed precision (10(0.642788): sin(40*pi/180) = 0.642788). The
% intermediate makes this fixture double as the known-bad test of the
% suppression pass itself — without suppression, 0.642788 is flagged and the
% no-flags assertion in run_tests.sh fails. The formulabox proves
% non-example content is ignored.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, mdframed, xcolor}
\newmdenv{formulabox}
\newmdenv{examplebox}
\newcommand{\ans}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\begin{document}

\section*{Skills Summary}

\begin{formulabox}
$\sin A = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$
\end{formulabox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} $A = 40^\circ$, $c = 10$. Find $a$.\\
$a = 10\sin 40^\circ = 10(0.642788) \approx \ans{6.43}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} A ramp runs $45$ and rises $30$. Find the angle.\\
$A = \tan^{-1}(30/45) \approx \ans{33.69^\circ}$
\end{examplebox}

\end{document}
